curatedMovie.curiosityHook: A staged casting call seems like an easy shortcut to romance, but what lies behind the quiet composure of the woman chosen?
curatedMovie.description: Years after losing his wife, widower Shigeharu stages a phony film audition to find a new partner. Enchanted by a quiet applicant named Asami, he soon discovers her gentle demeanor hides something far more twisted.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow-burning, heavy, and intensely suspenseful. A deliberate Japanese horror best experienced with focused attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Takashi Miike patient drama shifts into unnerving horror, trading standard shocks for a slow, deeply unsettling descent fueled by deceit and misplaced longing.
